guide.summary: Museums, volcanic viewpoints, gardens and Waiheke vineyards, with breakfasts, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
highlights: Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki
guide.tip: Auckland War Memorial Museum stays open until 8.30pm every Tuesday, so you can save it for an evening and keep the daytime for outdoor sights.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Torpedo Bay Navy Museum closes on Good Friday, Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Auckland Art Gallery, the New Zealand Maritime Museum and Auckland Zoo close only on Christmas Day.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Auckland Zoo's pre-booked prices for Auckland residents apply to tickets booked before midnight the day before. At Auckland Art Gallery, general collection exhibitions are free but Picasso: Designed by Paul Smith needs a ticket.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins
toolkit.copy: Depot Eatery takes walk-ins only and applies a one-bill policy to groups of four or more. Cassia and Bivacco take bookings but also welcome walk-ins.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: At Auckland Zoo, children 14 and under must be with an adult, and Auckland Art Gallery asks the same for under-14s. On Maungawhau / Mount Eden, dogs must be on a leash outside the two fenced off-leash areas.

guide.dek: Pair one museum or volcanic summit with a waterfront meal each day, and give Waiheke a full day of its own.
intro: Start in the city centre at Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki, on the corner of Wellesley Street East and Kitchener Street, open daily from 10am to 5pm except Christmas Day. Its general collection exhibitions are free, but Picasso: Designed by Paul Smith, running from 10 October 2026 to 1 February 2027, needs a ticket. In the Auckland Domain, Auckland War Memorial Museum stays open until 8.30pm every Tuesday. On the waterfront, the New Zealand Maritime Museum on Hobson's Wharf opens from 10am to 5pm with last entry at 4pm, and it's free for Auckland residents.

For a family day in Western Springs, Auckland Zoo at 99 Motions Road opens from 9.30am to 5.30pm with last entry at 4.30pm. Auckland residents pay less if they book before midnight the day before. MOTAT, at 805 Great North Road, opens daily from 10am to 4pm. You can only reach the top of Maungawhau / Mount Eden on foot, because its summit road is permanently closed to private vehicles, and summer hours run from 7am to 8.30pm. Further south, Auckland Botanic Gardens in Manurewa is free to enter, and Sculpture in the Gardens runs from 14 November 2026 to 28 February 2027.

Across the harbour, Torpedo Bay Navy Museum at 64 King Edward Parade in Devonport opens from 10am to 5pm every day except Good Friday, Christmas Day and Boxing Day. It's free for New Zealand residents, and international visitors aged 18 and over pay $15. On Waiheke Island, Cable Bay's cellar door at 12 Nick Johnstone Drive opens from 11am to 5pm daily, and its Verandah stays open late on Fridays and Saturdays. Mudbrick, at 126 Church Bay Road in Oneroa, takes table bookings online, but its website doesn't publish restaurant hours, so check before you sail.

Back in town, Depot Eatery at 86 Federal Street takes walk-ins only and serves breakfast from 7am on weekdays. Cassia at 58 Albert Street serves dinner seven nights a week from 5pm and welcomes walk-ins, and its Level 1 Cocktail Lounge opens on Thursday and Friday from 3pm to 5pm. Amano at 68 Tyler Street serves breakfast until 11.30am, and Amano Bakery at the same address opens daily from 7am to 4pm. Savor Group venues, including Amano, Ebisu and Bivacco, add a 15% surcharge to bills on public holidays.
summaryCards: Combine Auckland War Memorial Museum with a walk up Maungawhau / Mount Eden, then eat on the waterfront at Ebisu or Bivacco.
Have breakfast at Amano or Depot Eatery from 7am, then walk to Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki when it opens at 10am.
Book Picasso: Designed by Paul Smith tickets and any Auckland Zoo tickets ahead, and remember that Depot Eatery doesn't take reservations.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Sky Tower and Fullers360 ferry pages sent automated readers to a bot check, and La Cigale French Market, Man O' War and Hello Beautiful had certificate errors, so none of them could be read. Daily Bread, Kōkako, Eighthirty, Espresso Workshop and Devonport Chocolates returned rate-limit errors, and The Grove's site failed to load. SEA LIFE Kelly Tarlton's published no street address, and Auckland Council pages (Wintergardens, Arataki) returned HTTP 406. Auckland War Memorial Museum's regular weekly hours and Mudbrick's restaurant hours were not shown on the pages read, and Prego publishes "Open 7 Days" without times. Coffee coverage is thin because most specialty café sites could not be read.
